thread:
linda: Published RCA for the cache-eviction storm incident this morning. Internal doc: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.com/pm/1875302468 (internal).
postmortem-bot: RCA uploaded and indexed. Timeline, impact, root cause, and action table added. :robot_face:
rahul: TL;DR: a config rollout triggered simultaneous cache invalidations across several pools. The resulting cold-starts and KV miss surge produced elevated tail latency and retries for ~30 minutes. No customer data exposure.
eva: Adding a short exec summary and one-slide board note in the doc.
sam-pm: Copying top action items — owners, due dates. Please ACK and update ETAs inline.

- ACT-1 | Owner: rahul   | Implement propagation backoff + jitter for cache invalidations | Due: 2026-05-02
- ACT-2 | Owner: eva     | Add a post-deploy cache warmup job for critical pools | Due: 2026-05-05
- ACT-3 | Owner: sre     | Create alert for KV cache miss-rate spike and paging rule | Due: 2026-04-30
- ACT-4 | Owner: cs      | Draft customer-facing note and ops comms template | Due: 2026-05-01
- CHECKPOINT | All owners | Post a short status update in the doc by EOD 2026-04-28

sre: Will add the alert and test in staging today; will tag oncall when enabled.
rahul: Ill open the PR for backoff logic within 24h and link it in the doc.
eva: Warmup job is prototyped; will demo to infra tomorrow and follow with a small rollout plan.
cs: Drafting a concise customer note now; will send to legal for review and attach to the RCA.
sam-pm: Follow-up checkpoint meeting set for 2026-05-12 09:00 PT. Calendar invite and agenda added to the doc.
linda: Thanks all — please ACK the doc and your action rows. If you cant make the May 12 checkpoint, leave a short written status in the doc beforehand. Well treat that meeting as the closure checkpoint for this RCA. :white_check_mark:
